moa.t: Amoxicillin inhibits cell-wall synthesis, clavulanic acid inactivates β-lactamases, extending cover to β-lactamase-producing Staph. aureus, H. influenzae, E. coli and anaerobes

cautions.t: Rash is common in glandular fever
Reduce dose in severe renal impairment

adverse_effects.t: Diarrhoea, nausea, rash, candidiasis, cholestatic hepatitis, C. difficile colitis
